messages:
dana: Following up on the authz postmortem. We had permission-drift + token validation gaps; rotation missed a namespace group after the regex change. Need a short, concrete owner list and timeline.

hiro: Quick recap: rotation worker skipped namespaces because the new pattern didn't include namespaced-service-*; audit logs didn't catch the gap because token-usage telemetry was filtered at ingest. Two things: fix rotation, and close telemetry blind spots.

linda: I'll take telemetry/alerts (RD-9900). Deliverables: Splunk query, dashboard tile, and pager rule for tokens with ttl>45d or zero recent usage but long TTL. Draft by 2026-03-30.

ods-bot: note: ops schedules must be confirmed by infra before pager rules are applied.

hiro: I'll own rotation fix (RD-9901). Plan: add pattern regression tests, preflight validator, idempotency, canary mode, and rotation success/failure counters. ETA 2026-04-08.

dana: I'll own runbook + emergency rotate CLI (RD-9902). Runbook should include verification smoke tests (auth-check endpoints) and an emergency lambda to force-rotate a single service. Draft by 2026-03-28.

incident-bot: Created follow-up tasks: https://boards.redwood.ai/board/rd-authz-990  (RD-9900, RD-9901, RD-9902).

linda: Splunk WIP: ```index=auth_tokens sourcetype=rotate_logs OR sourcetype=token_usage | where ttl_days>45 OR (last_seen_ts < relative_time(now(), "-14d")) | stats latest(last_seen_ts) as last_seen by service, token_id``` Will refine and add a dashboard.

h iro: Manual rotation tonight for affected services: svc-metering -> ok, svc-billing -> ok, svc-notify -> failed until secret path remap. Logs: ```rotate svc-metering ok
rotate svc-billing ok
rotate svc-notify failed: secret_backend=/secret/legacy/notify not found```

security-eng: I'm running a quick inventory for legacy secret backends and tokens with ttl>45d. Will add CSV to the board and mark blockers. Also recommending a policy: require token_ttl<=90d except with explicit expemption notes.

dana: Include a recurring audit job that writes token inventory to S3 nightly and a one-week rolling alert if any token appears in the >45d bucket for more than 3 consecutive days. Add to RD-9900.

linda: I'll also add a temporary oncall watch for two weeks after alerts are live. Pager policy draft will be in alerts repo.

h iro: I'll instrument rotation metrics: rotation_runs_total{status="success"} and rotation_runs_total{status="failure"}, plus rotation_missed_patterns gauge. CI e2e: inject bad pattern and expect missed_patterns==0 post-corrective-run; block merges otherwise. PR planned RD-9941.

hiro: Manual remediation notes after infra remap: svc-notify rotation succeeded. Final logs: ```rotate svc-metering ok
rotate svc-billing ok
rotate svc-notify ok```

dana: Ownership summary: RD-9901 -> hiro -> 2026-04-08; RD-9900 -> linda -> draft 2026-03-30; RD-9902 -> dana -> 2026-03-28. Short sync Tue 2026-03-31 08:30 PT (15m). Target follow-up closure by 2026-04-18 if audits and CI checks pass.

security-eng: Scan uploaded to board. Found two additional services referencing legacy secret paths; marking them blockers for RD-9901.

hiro: Noted blockers; will include those services in the canary and CI e2e. Adding an alert: if rotation_runs_total{status="failure"} > 0 for 2 consecutive runs -> pager.

dana: I'll update the incident doc with owners and the emergency rotate CLI snippet. Will post runbook link here when ready. Thanks all.
